_comment: Where each Sentry alert's fix happens. The receiver picks a target by the alert's org (and project, when an org has several targets) and builds the run branch on its base; the runner reads the rest. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

checkout._frontend_projects: Alerts on these start a run too: the agent starts from the browser error (a 500 from /checkout) and follows its trace to the Flask error behind it. If another backend served that request, it stops without a fix
checkout._dashboard: Linked in Slack for metric alerts, before the draft PR opens

agent-context.check_label: policy answer under the token budget
agent-context._telemetry: After the fix PR opens, a second agent instruments the code with a Sentry Application Metric for this goal (its own PR into base), and the alert's thread links a pre-filled Sentry monitor form for it (nothing is created in Sentry)

telemetry.goal: the number of help-centre documents (policy pages) the shopping agent sends to the model for one question

agent-context._variants: with-seer's handoff (seer_handoff.py, fix_from_seer.md) is checkout-specific for now
